evidence: Receiving DO at t=52 h ≈ 11.5 mg/L (online sensor), trending similar to source batches; no near-limit values anywhere in 0–52 h.
Delayed P assay at t=23.8 h: 3.10 g/L, matching source-batch trajectories at same age.
physical_forward_model(keep): post-decision min DO 8.36 mg/L, below_limit_h=0, product mass 576.3 kg.

submission.rationale: Receiving observations (online DO ≈ 11.5 mg/L at 52 h, delayed P assay 3.10 g/L at 23.8 h) track the three source batches closely, indicating a normal run. The source-calibrated forward model for KEEP predicts post-decision minimum DO ≈ 8.36 mg/L (all 5 sensitivity members feasible, min 7.07 mg/L), far above the 2 mg/L hard limit, with product mass ≈ 576 kg — the highest among bounded plans, since feed reductions trade away mass while the oxygen constraint is not binding. No intervention is warranted.
submission.uncertainty: Model is source-calibrated and may mismatch the hidden receiving realization; the DO margin (≈6 mg/L above the limit, robust across all sensitivity members) far exceeds plausible forecast error. Residual risk is an unmodeled receiving-side disturbance, which the online DO sensor would catch before the constraint binds.
